title: Team routes delegate through thin controllers to use cases
decision: `GET`/`PATCH /api/teams/[teamId]` and `PATCH /api/teams/[teamId]/lineups` delegate through thin controllers to `GetTeamUseCase`, `UpdateTeamUseCase` and `UpdateTeamLineupsUseCase`, following `createTeamController` and registering the corresponding DI symbols. Authorization and input validation stay in the route layer.
consequences: The thin pass-through team use cases add ceremony, accepted for consistent Clean Architecture layering: three small files mirror `CreateTeamUseCase`.
